english: You approach the goods-hatch.
This is a very small goods-hatch.
This whole building appears to have been repurposed into a warehouse. Otherwise, making it this tiny would have been very silly.
So this is where they lower the goods.
Don't think the Freestriders will be too happy with someone sneaking in through the roof.
The goblin squats down and grabs the rusty hang-lock.
But damn. Look at this rusty thing. They really don't value security around here.
You approach the locked goods-hatch again.
Smash the lock.
Pick the lock.
E-(Just leave.)
With just a bit of force, the lock shatters.
You try to grab the lock. You try to pull it off. You try to jerk it.
You try to wrangle it on the spot. Really getting a death grip around it.
But no matter what you do, it just won't come off.
It's quite frustrating.
With just a bit of finesse, the lock cracks open.
Quite literally. This rusty piece of shit won't ever close again.
You try your best, but it just doesn't quite pop open.
Which is super annoying. Like, you SHOULD be able to do this.
Which is mostly due to your fingers just not doing what they're supposed to.
Oh well. Try again later, or something.
You speak the words and make the hand-movements. Then... that loud sound echoes throughout the entirety of Waterlane.
And the rusty lock shatters.
There we go.
Great job.
(Open the hatch.)
As you peek inside, you see a rope attached to the wood, tumbling down - into the open space below.
Sweet. Then we can actually climb back up. Didn't think of that.
Let's see how well this rope holds up...
Meek will help master climb! Meek can hold rope with teeth. Very strong.
Cool.
